name: stop-that-shit
description: Stop unneeded scope, subagents, dependencies, and hashes during code development.

interface.shortDescription: Keep code-development tasks from growing extra machinery.
interface.longDescription: Stop That Shit runs locally during code development and controls unneeded scope, subagents, dependencies, and hashes.
defaultPrompt: $stop-that-shit review -- Review this diff. Report findings; do not edit.
$stop-that-shit change -- Fix the failing test only.
$stop-that-shit lock change agents=0 -- Make the requested change without delegation.
